revenue_source: Tickertape financials page for BSE-listed Jay Ushin Ltd (JAYUSH), FY2025 and FY2026 total revenue in INR crore (https://www.tickertape.in/stocks/jay-ushin-JAYU); figures are aggregator-reported from company filings, not independently verified against the audited annual report
note: Entity exists and is listed on BSE (scrip code 520066, symbol JAYUSH); Tickertape profile describes it as engaged in manufacturing and sale of automotive lock and key sets, combination switches, heater control panels and door latches, hence role=manufacturer. CIN, PAN, GSTIN, incorporation date, registered-office state and MCA status could NOT be confirmed: web_search backend was down (connection refused) and registry aggregators (ZaubaCorp, TheCompanyCheck, InstaFinancials, QuickCompany) returned 403/404 or only landing pages, so these fields are null rather than guessed. Declared HS 830120 (padlocks/locks and key parts of base metal) is broadly consistent with its lock-and-key-set product line, but HS is not a rejection criterion per project rules. No rejection grounds found (no evidence of strike-off, liquidation or bankruptcy). Revenue figures are aggregator-sourced, not audited-account-verified; treat as indicative.
